query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM idempotency h WHERE h.conversation_id=$1 AND (h.execution_status='sending' OR (h.execution_status='delivered' AND h.updated_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => $3) AND h.updated_at > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=$1 AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL), '-infinity'::timestamptz) AND COALESCE((SELECT e.lifecycle FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id=$1 AND e.lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.seq DESC LIMIT 1), '') NOT IN ('run.started', 'run.resumed')) OR (h.execution_status='queued' AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR h.created_at <= COALESCE((SELECT MIN(w.created_at) FROM idempotency w WHERE w.conversation_id=$2 AND w.execution_status='queued'), 'infinity'::timestamptz))))) AS "undelivered!"
